title: ACFO: Geometry-prepared Fourier operators and coefficient-space operator synthesis
description: ACFO provides geometry-prepared Fourier operators and explicit construction of compatible coefficient-space actions. Version 0.3.0 adds self-contained two-machine validation packages for High-NA correspondence and harmonic support, WAXS candidate ranking, Cartesian ODT and coupled modal normal actions, radial CPSWF preparation and checked cache reuse, and layered vector-wave composite operators with derivatives. The source archive includes component code and tests, prespecified protocols and claim freeze, numerical arrays and raw timings, privacy-normalized original returns, the original second-machine ODT loader failure and its same-input corrective rerun, independent audits, thirteen numerical source-data tables, and a portable verifier. The evidence supports the tested finite geometries and subspaces with explicit comparator and support limits: the current WAXS payload lacks an equally contracted strongest comparator, the ODT paired hot-speed interval is absent, and Windows strict bitwise radial audit failures remain recorded. Composite performance refers to its own fixed unfused/materialized chain and retained-array storage. No universal speed or full-support/measured-data CPSWF reconstruction claim is made. Unlicensed third-party raw intensity is excluded; required geometry is retained. Existing v0.2.0 evidence and the established package API remain available. License: ACFO Citation-Required License, source-available and not OSI-approved.
